Bill.BriefDescription: Granting collective bargaining for postdoctoral researchers at certain state universities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to collective bargaining for postdoctoralresearchers at certain state universities; and adding a new section tochapter 41.56 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.56 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) In addition to the entities listed in RCW 41.56.020, thischapter applies to: (a) The University of Washington with respect to postdoctoralresearchers in a classification in subsection (2) of this section onany University of Washington campus; and (b) Washington State University with respect to postdoctoralresearchers in a classification in subsection (3) of this section onany Washington State University campus. (2) The employees in this subsection constitute an appropriatebargaining unit at the University of Washington: (a) Research associate; (b) Research associate trainee; (c) Senior fellow; p. 1 SB 6486 (d) Senior fellow trainee; and (e) All employees whose duties and responsibilities aresubstantially equivalent to those employees in (a) through (d) of thissubsection. (3) The employees in this subsection constitute an appropriatebargaining unit at Washington State University: (a) Postdoctoral research associate; and (b) All employees whose duties and responsibilities aresubstantially equivalent to those employees in (a) of this subsection.
